clusters.evidence_quote: Lysosomes were enriched ... using superparamagnetic iron oxide nanoparticles (SPIONs). ... cross-linked in two states (intact and disrupted) with the MS cleavable cross-linker disuccinimidyl sulfoxide (DSSO).
clusters.reasoning: All JS3_* files explicitly reference SPIONs and DDA/DIA acquisition modes, matching the publication workflow for DSSO crosslinked lysosomes/early endosomes. The GFP set is included because it appears within the same JS3 SPION/DDA/DIA naming scheme and likely corresponds to an experimental/standard condition in the same study; however, the exact biological meaning of GFP vs intact/disrupted is not fully specified in the provided text, so confidence is medium.

Without explicit crosslinker labeling for the FLOT_* and XL_Lys_* sets, assigning them to a DSSO cluster would be inference; therefore they are left unassigned.
